response:
Mm, smoke curling, okay — plant just... breathing light, basically. Photosynthesis: sunlight walks into a leaf, water and CO₂ show up quietly at the door, and inside — this tiny gold factory — light gets folded into sugar, glucose, like sunbeams learning to sit still and become food. Oxygen just kinda... sighs back out as the leftover breath.

Funny thing — that exhale is the same air we're pulling in right now, off this balcony, so every lungful is borrowed from a leaf somewhere being quietly amazing about it. Whole planet's just plants turning starlight into jars of stored sugar-time, one photon at a time. Kinda a big deal actually, ha, for something so small and green and unbothered.
